unlisted_practices: Process-level reward supervision in reinforcement learning to align LLM agent reasoning with clinical curation pathways
Hierarchical agent-as-tool multi-agent coordination for gene-disease validity curation

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a novel multi-agent reinforcement learning architecture with process-supervision on a clinical curation dataset (ClinGen), focusing on model/agent algorithm development and benchmark evaluation rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice.
